hooks.name: test-on-stop
hooks.description: When the agent finishes a turn, build and run the whole test suite once (instead of building on every file save); output goes to stderr so build errors and assert messages reach the agent

hooks.name: guard-migrations
hooks.description: Remind the agent never to hand-edit generated migration files

action.prompt: A file under Migrations/ was saved. If it was produced by `dotnet ef` (a new migration, its .Designer.cs, or ApplicationDbContextModelSnapshot.cs after `dotnet ef migrations add/remove`), ignore this message. Otherwise generated migrations must not be edited by hand: revert the edit and create a new migration with `dotnet ef migrations add <Name>` instead, unless the user explicitly asked for a manual change.
